title: Test Plan — Request a Test Plan
purpose: Source-documented only. The Help Center has a short 2024 article for a top-menu Test Plan. The published Product Profile guide instead shows a Test Plan (AI) pop-up on Quality Requirement. These may be different features. Do not merge them into one invented flow.
meta: How To Request A Test Plan
None on this page. The product-profile pop-up image is still pending review.
overview: **Historical Help Center path:** top menu **TEST PLAN**, then product details, then receive or download a PDF.
**Current published-guide path:** product profile → Quality Requirement → **Test Plan (AI)** pop-up.
The internal index previously marked Test Plan as coming soon. A dev check is still required.

body: This is the entire Help Center article. It was last edited on 2024-03-28.

olist: “Navigate to the top menu bar, select **TEST PLAN**.”
“Receive your test plan, you can also download it in PDF format.”

body: Do not assume the 2024 top-menu path still exists.

steps.h: 2. What the published guide already shows
body: The [[guide:product-profile|Product Profile]] guide documents a **Test Plan (AI)** control on Quality Requirement. Its pop-up slot is `27-test-plan.jpg`, still pending privacy review. That guide does not show a generated plan or an apply-to-requirements result.
Keep both descriptions until a dev check says they are the same feature.

tips: Do not copy Help Center screenshots. Do not invent a generated-plan screenshot.
faq: What still needs a dev check?

Whether a standalone Test Plan entry remains in the left or top navigation; its current fields, outputs, and any fee or token; and, if it is gone, whether this 2024 article should be retired in favour of a longer Quality Requirement Test Plan (AI) guide.
